label: Avasam

discovery.auth: header credentials `Authkey` (supplier code), `SessionToken` (authorisation token) and `AvasamID` (account id) — issued in the Avasam account

auth: 1. Tenant opens an Avasam seller account
3. Send the three as request headers / fields on every call

endpoints.purpose: catalogue with SKUs, descriptions, pricing, images

reference.limits: Not documented. - Seller account required (UK); API is the documented automation path - No sandbox / webhooks documented

reason: Seller API reference (https://help.avasam.com/docs/seller-api, re-opened 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium; same content as the static page) documents POST https://app.avasam.com/api/auth/request-token {consumer_key, secret_key} -> {access_token, expires_at} and calls such as POST /apiseeker/Products/GetSellerProductList {Page, Limit} and /apiseeker/Order/CreateSellerOrder, but never states how access_token is presented: each call only says 'with a valid token (Which can be obtained using the Login call)', and CreateSellerOrder instead lists an 'Authkey — Authorization key for the Avasam account' inside the JSON body without saying whether that is the access_token. There is no single-order read (only a date-window order list), and the Supplier API is for suppliers pushing stock. Mapping would mean guessing the token placement.
